header: Add this in Settings > Plugins > Advanced > Repository URL:

short.marklong.altmaster: check linked alt accounts, report a new alt, and appeal false positives from a profile menu
short.marklong.auto-show-all-channels: turns on Show All Channels by itself in every server you join
short.marklong.always-animate: animates profile pictures, banners, server icons, decorations, emoji, stickers and GIFs
short.marklong.better-devices: multi-select logout, new-device alerts and clearer device details
short.marklong.better-calls: silent calls with a bell button in DMs, and remembers your audio output device
short.marklong.bypass-status: get notifications from chosen people (or everyone) while on Do Not Disturb
short.marklong.chatbubbles: customizable chat bubbles with rounded corners and your own color
short.marklong.chatbox-avatar: a button in the chatbox to view your profile or open your account sheet
short.marklong.colorful-channels: colored channel icons for locked and NSFW channels, plus a red NSFW tag
short.marklong.crop-plus: crop pictures much smaller than Discord allows by cropping the result again
short.marklong.custom-sounds: replace any Discord sound with your own link, with seasonal packs
short.marklong.custom-rpc-test: a test of Rich Presence that shows several presences at once, each profile on its own switch
short.marklong.force-timestamp-locale: show every timestamp in one language, such as en-gb 24-hour times
short.marklong.haptics: turn Discord's buzzing on or off, with a log of what buzzed
short.marklong.hypesquad: change your HypeSquad house, or leave it, in one tap
short.marklong.markdown-toolbar: a floating formatting bar under the chat input that pops up with the keyboard
short.marklong.message-preview: preview your message before sending it
short.marklong.message-reminders: hold a message, tap Remind Me, and get a Jump / Snooze / Done sheet when it's due
short.marklong.minecraft-servers: see if your servers are online, who is playing, and the ping
short.marklong.nef-viewer: shows RAW photos (Nikon, Canon, Sony, Fujifilm and more) in chat, with a photo info sheet
short.marklong.no-suggestions: removes the Suggested channels section that keeps coming back
short.marklong.pin-dms: pin DMs and group chats to the top, in sections you can fold
short.marklong.quiet-hours: switches your status to Do Not Disturb on a schedule and puts it back, with one-tap skip tonight
short.marklong.repo-post: keeps your repository thread post up to date with the plugin list and versions
short.marklong.rich-presence: fully custom rich presence with profiles, images, timers and buttons
short.marklong.role-options: copy a role's name, color or icon from the role menu
short.marklong.server-drawer: manage your servers from a drawer above the YouBar
short.marklong.server-info: members, roles, channels, boosts, owner and friends for any server
short.marklong.slowmode-extended: more slowmode choices, from every second up to 6 hours
short.marklong.soundcloud-presence: show your SoundCloud track on your profile (works with Last.fm)
short.marklong.split-large-messages: automatically splits messages over the character limit
short.marklong.spotify-tools: Listen Along button, plus send your song or album from the + menu
short.marklong.status-presets: save statuses as presets and switch with one tap, with Undo
short.marklong.text-react: hold a message and add text as reactions, like letters, numbers and words such as "ok"
